about.streak: flag or relay i fired in rounds t-1 and t (x_{i,t-1} = x_{i,t} = 1)
about.A: unit = (job, circuit, series, round t); groups streak (1,1), single (0,1), quiet (0,0); outcome = fraction of the patch's near (share a data qubit) or far stabilizer detectors firing in round t + lag; D = sum w (ybar1 - ybar0) / sum w, w = n1 n0 / (n1 + n0); model = same w, exact model probabilities; CIs over shots (linearized) and clustered by physical qubit
about.B: strata (job, circuit, patch); exposed = a streak on any flag or relay of the patch; Mantel-Haenszel RD (Sato) and RR (Greenland-Robins); count matched = strata also by the number K of flag and relay firings in the patch; failure_per_firing = within-stratum least-squares slope of the failure on K; model = the same on its sampled, decoded shots

circuits: memory, rounds >= 2, X and Z, 15 jobs; model shots 20000 per circuit, seed 7000 + setting index
